claims.title: Player-local game traffic may expose player data without verified protection
claims.description: If `encryption_in_transit` on `flow:entity:player>process:game-client>launch-and-play` is absent or ineffective, another user or malware on the player-controlled machine can read player input and game output, including the player-associated PII handled at this endpoint. This is conditional: the flow's protection is unverified, not stated absent. The disclosure can enable targeted abuse of the player's game account or social-engineering against that player.

severity.justification: Likelihood is medium and conditional because `unknown:flow:entity:player>process:game-client>launch-and-play:encryption_in_transit` leaves local-channel protection unverified, while local observation requires access to the player's machine. Impact is low because the disclosed content is associated with one player's `pii`-tagged endpoint rather than a store-wide corpus.

mitigations.summary: Verify protection of local client data
mitigations.detail: Establish whether sensitive player data is protected while handled by `process:game-client`; minimize retained plaintext and use operating-system protected storage for any account or personal data.

claims.title: Matchmaking traffic may be readable across the player-to-production boundary
claims.description: `flow:process:game-client>process:lobby>matchmaking` crosses from `boundary:player-local-machine` to the production network and carries matchmaking requests and match assignments. If its unverified `encryption_in_transit` is not protected, an attacker able to observe a player's network path can intercept player-associated matchmaking data. The disclosed assignments and identifiers enable targeting specific players and reconnaissance of active matches.

severity.justification: Likelihood is medium and conditional because the flow crosses a trust boundary but `unknown:flow:process:game-client>process:lobby>matchmaking:encryption_in_transit` leaves transport confidentiality unverified. Impact is medium because the candidate identifies PII in transit and the lobby is an internet-facing production service.

mitigations.detail: Use TLS 1.2+ for `flow:process:game-client>process:lobby>matchmaking`, with certificate validation by `process:game-client`, and record the verified transport setting in the model.

claims.title: Gameplay traffic may disclose match state across the player boundary
claims.description: `flow:process:game-client>process:game-server>gameplay-traffic` crosses from a player-controlled machine into production and carries gameplay actions and state updates. If `encryption_in_transit` is absent when its current `unknown` value is resolved, an on-path observer can read live match state and player actions. That intelligence can enable real-time targeting of players and undermine the confidentiality of business-critical game state.

severity.justification: Likelihood is medium and conditional because this is a decided player-to-production crossing and `unknown:flow:process:game-client>process:game-server>gameplay-traffic:encryption_in_transit` does not verify protection. Impact is medium because `process:game-server` handles `business-critical-data` and the flow exposes live gameplay state.

mitigations.detail: Protect `flow:process:game-client>process:game-server>gameplay-traffic` with TLS or an equivalently authenticated encrypted game transport, including certificate validation and key rotation.

claims.title: Lobby-to-game-server match handoff may reveal player identifiers
claims.description: `flow:process:lobby>process:game-server>hand-over-match` carries match composition and player identifiers between production processes. If its `encryption_in_transit: unknown` resolves to no effective transport protection, an attacker with a foothold on the production path can intercept participant identities and match composition. The information enables targeted player reconnaissance and can be correlated with the game-server's business-critical match processing.

severity.justification: Likelihood is low and conditional because `unknown:flow:process:lobby>process:game-server>hand-over-match:encryption_in_transit` leaves confidentiality unverified, but observation of an intra-production path requires a prior production-network foothold. Impact is medium because the handoff carries player identifiers and controls match composition consumed by `process:game-server`.

mitigations.detail: Use mutually authenticated TLS between `process:lobby` and `process:game-server` and set the flow's `encryption_in_transit` to the verified protocol.

claims.title: Player account records may be exposed on the lobby database read path
claims.description: `flow:process:lobby>store:player-database>read-players` reads player account records from `store:player-database`. If the flow's `encryption_in_transit` is unprotected when its current `unknown` value is resolved, an attacker on the production network path can intercept PII and player-record data as the lobby reads it. Those records can then support impersonation attempts or targeted abuse against the affected players.

severity.justification: Likelihood is low and conditional because `unknown:flow:process:lobby>store:player-database>read-players:encryption_in_transit` is unverified and interception requires a production-network position. Impact is medium because the flow carries player account records from the `pii`-tagged `store:player-database`.

mitigations.summary: Require encrypted database reads from the lobby
mitigations.detail: Configure authenticated TLS for `flow:process:lobby>store:player-database>read-players` and restrict database network access to the lobby identity and required endpoint.

claims.title: Game-server statistics traffic may expose business-critical match data
claims.description: `flow:process:game-server>store:stats-database>read-write-stats` carries match statistics to and from `store:stats-database`. If its `encryption_in_transit` is absent or ineffective, despite currently being `unknown`, an attacker able to observe the production path can intercept match statistics. The data can expose game outcomes and operationally valuable player-performance information.

severity.justification: Likelihood is low and conditional because `unknown:flow:process:game-server>store:stats-database>read-write-stats:encryption_in_transit` leaves protection unverified and an attacker needs production-network path access. Impact is medium because the flow and `store:stats-database` handle `business-critical-data`.

mitigations.detail: Require TLS with service authentication on `flow:process:game-server>store:stats-database>read-write-stats` and prevent non-approved production principals from observing the database network path.

claims.title: Player progression updates may disclose player records in transit
claims.description: `flow:process:game-server>store:player-database>update-players` carries player progression and match results into the PII-tagged `store:player-database`. If the unverified `encryption_in_transit` control is absent, a production-network observer can intercept player progression, results, and associated record data. The disclosure enables targeted profiling of players and reveals data subsequently available through the player-record store.

severity.justification: Likelihood is low and conditional because `unknown:flow:process:game-server>store:player-database>update-players:encryption_in_transit` does not establish a protected channel and the attacker needs a production-network position. Impact is medium because the destination store is tagged `pii` and `business-critical-data`.

mitigations.detail: Enforce mutually authenticated TLS on `flow:process:game-server>store:player-database>update-players` and limit database ingress to the game-server workload identity.

claims.title: Support moderation traffic may expose player account data across the corporate boundary
claims.description: `flow:entity:customer-support-staff>process:moderation-website>moderate-accounts` crosses from `boundary:corporate-network` into production and carries moderation actions on player accounts. If its `encryption_in_transit` is absent when the current `unknown` is resolved, an observer on the corporate or production-facing path can intercept player-account moderation data. The disclosure can enable targeting of players and expose support actions that reveal account status or enforcement history.

severity.justification: Likelihood is medium and conditional because the support flow is a decided corporate-to-production crossing and `unknown:flow:entity:customer-support-staff>process:moderation-website>moderate-accounts:encryption_in_transit` leaves confidentiality unverified. Impact is medium because the flow handles PII-tagged player-account moderation information.

mitigations.summary: Require TLS for the moderation website
mitigations.detail: Serve `flow:entity:customer-support-staff>process:moderation-website>moderate-accounts` only through TLS with managed certificates, enforce HTTPS, and prevent downgrade or plaintext access.

claims.title: Moderation website database traffic may expose player records
claims.description: `flow:process:moderation-website>store:player-database>read-write-players` carries player account records and moderation state directly to `store:player-database`. If its `encryption_in_transit: unknown` resolves to an unprotected connection, a production-network observer can intercept player PII and moderation state. The disclosed account and enforcement data can enable targeted harassment, privacy harm, and attacks against affected accounts.

severity.justification: Likelihood is low and conditional because `unknown:flow:process:moderation-website>store:player-database>read-write-players:encryption_in_transit` is unverified and interception requires access to the production-side path. Impact is medium because the flow carries PII-tagged player records and moderation state.

mitigations.detail: Use mutually authenticated TLS for `flow:process:moderation-website>store:player-database>read-write-players` and isolate the database endpoint from unapproved production-network observers.

claims.title: A copied player database may expose player records if storage encryption is absent
claims.description: `store:player-database` contains PII and business-critical player records, while `encryption_at_rest` is `unknown`. If that unknown resolves to unencrypted storage, an attacker who obtains a decommissioned volume, snapshot, backup, or other operational copy can read the records without using the lobby, game-server, or moderation-website access paths. This is conditional and does not assert that encryption is absent. A raw copy can expose the player corpus and supply data for account targeting and social engineering.

severity.justification: Likelihood is medium and conditional because `unknown:store:player-database:encryption_at_rest` leaves protection of storage copies unverified, while obtaining a copy requires storage-layer access. Impact is high because one copy exposes the PII and business-critical player-record corpus, and disclosure cannot be revoked.

mitigations.summary: Verify and enforce encryption at rest for player records
mitigations.detail: Establish the at-rest control for `store:player-database`, then require KMS-managed envelope encryption for the primary store and every backup, snapshot, replica, and export.
Limit snapshot, backup, restore, and export permissions to separate least-privilege principals and audit all copy operations.

claims.title: A copied statistics database may disclose match data if storage encryption is absent
claims.description: `store:stats-database` holds business-critical match statistics and has `encryption_at_rest: unknown`. If that unresolved attribute means storage is unencrypted, a person who acquires an operational storage copy can read the statistics directly, bypassing `process:game-server`. This conditional disclosure can reveal historical game outcomes and analytics useful for operational or competitive intelligence.

severity.justification: Likelihood is medium and conditional because `unknown:store:stats-database:encryption_at_rest` leaves the protection of disks and operational copies unverified, although acquiring a copy needs storage-layer access. Impact is medium because the store contains `business-critical-data` for match statistics.

mitigations.summary: Encrypt statistics storage and its copies
mitigations.detail: Verify the at-rest posture of `store:stats-database` and enforce managed-key encryption for the store, backups, snapshots, replicas, and exports.

claims.title: Unverified player-database authentication may permit unauthorized account-record reads
claims.description: `process:lobby` reads `store:player-database` through `flow:process:lobby>store:player-database>read-players`, and `process:moderation-website` reads it through `flow:process:moderation-website>store:player-database>read-write-players`. Authentication on both database paths is unknown. If either unresolved control permits unauthenticated, weakly authenticated, or over-broad access, an attacker reaching that database service can query player account records and moderation state beyond the intended caller. The resulting PII disclosure can be used to target player accounts and exposes a corpus rather than only a single support request.

severity.justification: Likelihood is medium and conditional because both `unknown:flow:process:lobby>store:player-database>read-players:authentication` and `unknown:flow:process:moderation-website>store:player-database>read-write-players:authentication` leave the database read controls unverified, though an attacker must reach the service. Impact is high because `store:player-database` contains PII and business-critical player records that its named readers access directly.

mitigations.detail: Assign separate authenticated identities to `process:lobby` and `process:moderation-website`, deny all other database clients by default, and restrict each identity to required rows, fields, and operations.
Apply object-level and role-based checks to player-record reads, and log and alert on bulk or cross-account query behavior.

claims.title: Unverified statistics-database authentication may expose match statistics
claims.description: `process:game-server` reads and writes `store:stats-database` through `flow:process:game-server>store:stats-database>read-write-stats`, but authentication on that path is unknown. If this unresolved control permits weak, missing, or over-broad database access, an attacker who reaches the database interface can request match statistics outside the game server's intended use. The disclosure provides historical game and performance information that can be used for operational or competitive reconnaissance.

severity.justification: Likelihood is medium and conditional because `unknown:flow:process:game-server>store:stats-database>read-write-stats:authentication` leaves the read-path access control unverified, while an attacker must reach the database interface. Impact is medium because `store:stats-database` holds business-critical match statistics.

mitigations.summary: Authenticate and scope game-server database access
mitigations.detail: Require a distinct workload identity for `process:game-server`, deny unauthenticated database access, and grant only the statistics rows and operations necessary for match processing.
Record database reads by workload identity and alert on volumes or query patterns inconsistent with game-server match processing.
